run_print_banner: run the platform_info module to print a one-line platform and accelerator summary banner
build_accelerator_label: build a string label describing the detected hardware accelerator such as CUDA, CoreML, or CPU
test_camera_backends: test the camera_backends function to get ordered OpenCV backend attempts for the current OS
summarize_platform_flags: summarize the platform detection flags like IS_WINDOWS, IS_MACOS, IS_LINUX, and IS_APPLE_SILICON
review_onnx_providers: review the ONNX execution providers detected on the current system including CUDA, CoreML, and DML
